1.body:
Hello,

I applied for the UI/UX Designer role at Data Eminence, specifically drawn to the opportunity to build design systems and collaborate closely with engineering teams.

During my UI/UX internship at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing, wireframing, and prototyping while translating findings directly into user flows. My current work as a graphic designer at Ascent Business Solutions has also sharpened my typography, layout, and visual hierarchy skills. My B.Tech in Computer Science from RGCERT Chandrapur helps me bridge the gap during developer handoffs.

My B2B case study Bounceless demonstrates my structured approach to user flows and wireframing at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a brief fifteen-minute call to discuss how my background fits your product team?

Ananya

2.body:
Hello,

I saw the Digital Creative Designer opening at VRT Management Group, and your focus on building scalable businesses that scale with intention caught my attention.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I produced over 100 digital and print creatives including marketing collateral, presentations, and branding assets while partnering closely with management stakeholders. I also built reusable design systems and templates that reduced turnaround time for recurring corporate communications.

My brand identity work for the AT Creation startup startup demonstrates my approach to visual identity and brand execution, which you can view in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and am ready to relocate for this onsite role in Hyderabad. Would you be open to a quick look at my branding work?

Ananya
